title: docs(skills): list job, queue and messaging only under --preset minimal; name the mcp and pinyin-search host defaults
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x2BodzmUyLwzK7D1MRbrXy7)_

Fixes #31184

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling); it is waived by the standing order of the maintainer in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-automation` 前置能力表把 `job`、`queue`、`messaging` 三行标 °，表后加一句「常驻，只在 `--preset minimal` 下才需列出（见 objectstack-platform § `requires:`）」，三行原有的症状保留（minimal 下仍成立）；`examples-flows.md` 与 `integration-recipes.md` 三处 `requires:` 数组去掉常驻 token；`objectstack-platform` § `requires:` 导语补一句：宿主默认 `mcp`（`OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false` 关闭）与 `pinyin-search`（`i18n` 含 `zh-*` 语言时开启，`OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED` 可覆盖）在任何预设下都挂载；automation 三个 eval 用例不再要求把常驻 token 写进 `requires`。
- 为什么改：`resolveServedCapabilities` 在非 minimal 预设下把常驻清单（含 `queue`、`job`、`messaging`）追加到每个应用的 `requires`，`serve` 另在任何预设下追加 `mcp` / `pinyin-search`；技能仍按旧的 opt-in 读法教，作者会把常驻服务当成必须声明的，且「其余服务插件都是 opt-in」对这两个宿主默认不成立（#31184，源自 PR #31181 复核）。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字、eval 与 changeset；四个受限文件全部在上限内，无棘轮上调（automation SKILL.md 6426 → 6414 / 6426，platform SKILL.md 6004 → 6004 / 6011）；增长由同文件删除重复文字支付，每处删除的归宿见下文；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § `requires:` 导语第三行；然后 `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` § Prerequisite 表与表后脚注。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（全绿，四个文件均有余量）；`grep -n "'job'\|'queue'" skills/objectstack-automation/references/*.md` 不再命中 `requires:` 数组；对照 `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` L3007-L3009 与 `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` L115-L140 读导语新句。
- 需要你做的：`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`），需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准；席位契约复核 ACCEPT 后再批。

## Code sites per taught sentence (read on `main` `59d9815a`; the branch is rebased on `7c523aa1`, which touches none of these files)

| Taught sentence | Code site |
|:--|:--|
| automation: `job`, `queue`, `messaging` are always-on (°) | `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L350 `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`, L357 (`'queue', 'job'`), L369 (`'messaging'`) |
| automation: list them only under `--preset minimal` | `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` L130-L134: the slate is appended `if (opts.preset !== 'minimal')`; `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` L2971 (`presetName`, default `'default'`) and L3009 |
| automation: the rows' symptoms stay (scheduled flows never launch, inbound POST 503, notify `skipped: true`) | unchanged rows; they describe a boot without the provider, which only `--preset minimal` produces |
| examples / recipes: `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']` suffices for `timeRelative`, the Stripe sweep and the carrier callback | same slate rule as above; the sweep cadence still runs on `job` (`packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` L112-L116 `triggers` comment) |
| platform: host defaults are mounted under every preset | `capability-composition.ts` L127-L129: `hostDefaults` are appended before, and independent of, the `preset !== 'minimal'` branch; `serve.ts` L3006-L3009 builds them for every `presetName` |
| platform: `mcp` unless `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false` | `serve.ts` L3007; `packages/types/src/env.ts` L633-L639 `isMcpServerEnabled`: unset ⇒ on; `0` / `false` / `off` / `no` ⇒ off |
| platform: `pinyin-search` when `i18n` names a `zh-*` locale, `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED` overrides | `serve.ts` L3008; `env.ts` L804 `stampSearchPinyinEnabled` → L755 `resolveSearchPinyinEnabled` (a non-empty env value wins: truthy on, anything else off; unset ⇒ any `zh-*` locale) over L770 `collectConfiguredLocales` (`i18n.defaultLocale`, `fallbackLocale`, `supportedLocales`) |

The order also suggested teaching that "`requires: ['mcp']` works whatever the env var says" (from the `serve.ts` comment at L2994-L2995). This PR does **not** teach it: the plugin loads, but `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` L112-L114 answers `404 MCP server is not enabled` on `/api/v1/mcp` whenever `isMcpServerEnabled()` is false, listed or not. See other sites.

### Deletions and their homes

| File · deleted text | Facts it held | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|:--|
| automation SKILL.md § Trigger Configuration: the blockquote `` `previous` (before the change) vs `record` (after) in an update trigger's condition: see [objectstack-formula](../objectstack-formula/SKILL.md) §5. `` | `previous` is the pre-change row and `record` the post-change row in an update condition; objectstack-formula §5 owns it | objectstack-formula `SKILL.md` § "5. Update hook condition — `previous` vs `record`" (L305ff, with the binding table); the same file's start-node example L393 (`previous.status != 'escalated' && record.status == 'escalated'`); the skill's lead L29-L32 and frontmatter send CEL conditions to objectstack-formula |
| platform SKILL.md § Naming Conventions: the row `` Barrel exports · `Object.values(imported)` · `objects: Object.values(objects)` `` | a barrel's exports are passed to a stack key with `Object.values` | `references/bootstrap.md` § Barrel Import Pattern (L53ff: `objects: Object.values(objects)` and the rest), linked from SKILL.md L70 |
| platform SKILL.md § Runtime Boot Sequence: `; absent in the open framework per cloud ADR-0025` on the `AIServicePlugin` line | the plugin is absent from the open framework; the decision is cloud ADR-0025 | the same line keeps "cloud / EE only — reverse-mounted by a cloud host"; `references/bootstrap.md` L98: "**Cloud / EE only** — `@objectstack/service-ai` moved to cloud (cloud ADR-0025); the open edition has no in-UI AI plugin" |
| platform SKILL.md, Port resolution pointer: ` (dev hops to the next free port, production fails loudly)` | dev hops to the next free port; production fails | `references/operations.md` § Ports & networking L65 (Dev: "Auto-hops to the next free port (up to +100)") and L66 (Production: "**Fails loudly and exits 1.**"), the link that stays on the line |

The Seed Data `mode` line was considered and **not** cut: `check-skill-identifier-liveness` registers `## Seed Data` as exhaustive over `SeedMode` (entry `seed-modes`), so it is pinned (see other sites for its wrong default).

## Eval cases touched

Every case below was re-read with `must_contain` against `expected_output` (each string present) and `must_not_contain` against it (none present).

| Fixture · case | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` case 2 | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers`, `messaging`, else notify reports success with `skipped: true`"; `must_contain` held `"messaging"` | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers`: `messaging` is always-on, listed only under `--preset minimal` (else notify reports success with `skipped: true`)"; `"messaging"` dropped from `must_contain`, so an answer that rightly leaves `messaging` out of `requires` is not failed |
| same file, case 14 | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers`, `messaging`." | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers` (`messaging` is always-on)." |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` case 2 | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers`, `job`." | "`requires` lists `automation`, `triggers` (`job` is always-on)." |

`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`: no case carries the old claim. Cases 3, 9 and 20 already teach the always-on reading (PR #31181); case 20's "a token outside that set, such as `automation` or `mailbox`, mounts only when `requires:` lists it" names two tokens that are not host defaults, so it stays true.

Pre-existing, not changed (outside the old claim): `integrations-declared.json` case 2 has `must_contain` `"dialect: 'cel'"`, which its `expected_output` does not spell (it says "via CEL"); case 1 has `must_contain` `"type: 'api'"` absent from, and `must_not_contain` `"connector-esign"` present in, its `expected_output` (that one names a rejected option).

## Other sites found (not changed here)

1. **Card item 5, spec lane:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L385-L392, the `'package-registry'` jsdoc, still says the token is inert under `objectstack serve` because `Serve.CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` "keys `marketplace`, not this token". `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` L174 now keys `'package-registry'`. Re-read on `main` `59d9815a`: still stale.
2. **`serve.ts` L2994-L2995 comment:** "Explicit `requires: ['mcp']` in config works regardless of the env var." The MCP plugin loads, but the HTTP route refuses: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` L112-L114 (and L203 for the skill route) answers 404 whenever `isMcpServerEnabled()` is false. A CLI-lane comment (or a behaviour ruling).
3. **Platform SKILL.md § `requires:` lead:** "`--preset minimal` drops exactly those" is not exact for `job` and `queue`: `capability-composition.ts` L135-L138 adds them back under any preset when `email`, `approvals` or `auth` is in the token list (`NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE`, L86), and `auth` pulls in `email`. Not taught anywhere; the automation footnote ("list it only under `--preset minimal`") stays true.
4. **Platform SKILL.md § Seed Data:** "`mode` (`upsert` default · …)" names the wrong default. `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` L207 is `SeedMode.default('ignore')`, as objectstack-data `references/seeds.md` § Import modes teaches. Outside this card's claimed section; the fix is byte-neutral.
5. **`examples/app-showcase`:** `objectstack.config.ts` L109 lists `'messaging'` and `'job'` in `requires`, and `src/automation/flows/index.ts` L423 and L647 tell the reader to install `requires: ['automation', 'triggers', 'job', 'messaging']`. Listing an always-on token is harmless (it makes the provider a hard requirement), but the comments teach the old reading.
6. Apart from item 5 and the three sites this PR fixes, nothing under `content/`, `skills/`, `examples/` or `apps/` lists `job`, `queue` or `messaging` in a `requires:` array (grep).
